name: tinker
line: internal tools on data you can't see
question: What if you could build internal tools on personal data nobody can read without a second person's approval?
body: An ontology-driven builder in Rust on PostgreSQL 18. Define an object once and get a row-level-secured table, a governed API and an MCP front door for agents. Email and phone are sealed by type in a separate vault: queries see a mask, automations get a key, and a person sees the value only after a second person approves. Erasure is a crypto-shred.
alt: tinker — internal tools on data you can't see
